$usertotalcommandsrun commands, $usertotaltimestagged tags, $usertotalamountdonated donated, $usermoderationstrikes strikes

$useraccountage ($useraccountdays days)
$userfollowage = $userfollowdays days = $userfollowmonths months = $userfollowyears years
$usersubage ($usersubdays days, $usersubmonths months, $usersubtier)
$userlastseenage ($userlastseendays days) since $userlastseendate
$usernotes
# B2: the rest of the token stays
$usernames $UserNameX

$targetusercolor / $targetuserfollowage / $targetusersubtier / $targetuserisfollower
